title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
snippet: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
snippet: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

title: Fort Hood survivor supports gunman's execution by firing squad but questions livestream
snippet: Alonzo Lunsford tells the BBC the punishment befits the crime but he has some doubts whether the public should be able to watch it.

title: US imposes sanctions on International Criminal Court
snippet: The US says the measures are aimed at restricting the tribunal's resources and ability to operate.

title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
snippet: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
snippet: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
snippet: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
snippet: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

title: ICE agent shoots man in New York City
snippet: The mayor of New York expressed outrage at the shooting which the Department of Homeland Security said happened during the arrest of a "criminal illegal alien".

title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
snippet: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.

title: Crazy Rich Asians to return as TV show with original film's stars
snippet: It will pick up after the hit 2018 film, starring Constance Wu, Henry Golding, Michelle Yeoh and Ronny Chieng.

title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
snippet: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.

title: Doctor accused of 1994 Rwanda genocide offences to face trial in UK
snippet: Dr Vincent Brown was allegedly a "leader" or "supervisor" of violent acts carried out by others in the early days of the genocide.

title: Two Renoir paintings stolen from French museum are recovered
snippet: The two works were seized last month when thieves cut through a fence and smashed a window at the Renoir Museum on the French Riviera.

title: Cars torched and shops looted as anti-migrant violence erupts in South Africa
snippet: South Africa has experienced recurrent outbreaks of violence, often targeting migrants from neighbouring countries.

title: Christa Pike has 'profound' health turnaround after botched execution, lawyers say
snippet: Pike's lawyers say her recovery is "remarkable" as they give an update on her condition after she survived an execution attempt by lethal injection.

title: Fired OpenAI researchers say they were let go for 'prioritising safety'
snippet: The AI firm instead claims the researchers were fired for mishandling sensitive information.

title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
snippet: The German sportswear brand wants the Sydney-based label to stop selling the clothes and pay damages.

title: Russian strikes and approaching winter force some in Kyiv to pack bags and flee
snippet: A renewed Russian campaign of strikes on power and energy infrastructure has made some contemplate leaving Ukraine's capital.

title: Meet India's feisty Gen Z protester who is taking on Modi
snippet: Neha Bora has emerged as one of the most recognisable faces from India's recent Gen Z-led protests.

title: Mark Zuckerberg has an image problem - so why is Meta's business booming?
snippet: A new film paints the Meta founder as a villain. But the tech firm seems immune to bad publicity, writes our North America tech correspondent.

title: Why Elon Musk is taking on India's richest man over Starlink
snippet: Musk has taken pot-shots at Reliance owner Mukesh Ambani as Starlink struggles to launch in India.

title: Watch: 'I am Jane Doe' protests across US call for end to sexual violence
snippet: Protests against sexual violence took place across more than 40 US states on 8 October.

title: Why is it so hard to put out Indonesian fires shrouding the region in toxic smog?
snippet: We explain why Indonesia’s peatland fires are so difficult to battle and produce so much haze.

title: Fleeing Kyiv for the countryside ahead of winter
snippet: A Kyiv resident told the BBC she has moved away from "everything that can be a Russian target" as Ukraine braces for another cold winter under intense attacks.

title: ​​USS Lincoln finally docks in San Diego after 10-month mission
snippet: The US aircraft carrier was set to return in May but the war with Iran has kept it at sea on one of the longest deployments ever.
